LIST nm, f FROM Set [has SetCode: 'CSP'] has SetName nm AND ALSO has SetIsForeignOnly f
note: The model has no fact type linking Card to Set (CardSetCode and SetCode are separate value types with no reading between them), so a single connected path from 'Adarkar Valkyrie' to its Set does not exist. The set code 'CSP' was found with a separate lookup (LIST c, r FROM Card has CardName n AND ALSO has CardSetCode c AND ALSO has CardIsReprint r WHERE n = 'Adarkar Valkyrie') and used as a literal; CSP is the non-reprint (original) printing. All 5 printings' sets (C14, C18, CSP, MMA, PLIST) share SetIsForeignOnly = 0, so the answer (No) is the same regardless of which printing is picked.

note: The play format with the highest banned count was found first with a grouped aggregate (LIST f, c FROM Legality lg [has LegalityStatus: 'Banned'] has LegalityFormat f AND ALSO THE COUNT OF lg GROUPED BY f AS c ORDERED WITH c DESCENDING THE FIRST 5), which gave legacy=546 as the top format; that literal is embedded in the final query since the model has no single-query top-N-then-filter construct.
